scope: SCOPED to civil jurisdiction and its costs consequences, one module. s 2 (the limits), s 19 (District Court jurisdiction and exclusions), s 22 (abandoning the excess), s 23 (jurisdiction by agreement), s 35 (no division of causes of action), s 39 (costs where an action could have been in a State Court), ss 50(2) and 51(2) (territorial criminal jurisdiction), s 52(1A) (Magistrates' Court exclusions). Not encoded: Parts 2 and 3, ss 24 to 34 and 36 to 49B otherwise, criminal powers, transfers, Part 5 and Part 6. Appeals are in the supreme-court-of-judicature-act-1969 row.
